text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"—That concludes this week's classes. 
Everyone, have a fulfilling weekend."

text_block_list.name: Everyone in Class
text_block_list.text: "Thank you so much—!"

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Right, Craft-san, Cesario-san, 
Messiah-san, and Heart-san have the Oka 
Sho, so they're heading out early 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Best of luck. Everyone in class, please 
cheer her on if you'd like."

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Like, isn't this insane?! Our class has 
FOUR girls running in the Oka Sho!! I'm 
getting so hyped up over here!!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's aiming for the Triple Tiara, 
and just making it to the first leg is 
already amazing on its own~... I'm 
cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks♪ I'll bring back a spectacular 
result, so look forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You and I, along with Craft, fought it out 
in the Fillies' Revue, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's the first time all four of us, 
including you, are competing against each 
other, isn't it, Cesario? —I can't wait♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"We both sprinted forward aiming for the 
same summit, to claim the glory of the 
Tiara for ourselves. Perhaps it was 
destiny that we would clash eventually."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no intention of falling 
behind anyone. The Cherry Blossom crown... 
belongs to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I can't just let that slide.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My unyielding feelings are no different 
from yours. No—I shall prove they surpass 
yours.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Craft-san. Heart-san. Cesario-san... and 
you, as well."

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaa, the sparks are really flying...! 
Messiah and the others are so passionate 
about the Triple Tiara, it's incredible.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but when it comes to having big dreams 
of becoming a Tiara Umamusume, it's gotta 
be—

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"Are you fired up too, Craft? Like, 'I 
definitely can't afford to lose here if I 
want to achieve the Triple Tiara!!'?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Aha, true! The Oka Sho is a race I 
absolutely want to win.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, as for me—I'm not planning to aim 
for the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...!? Craft, what's the meaning of 
this...!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I talked it over with Trainer and made up 
my mind. Taking my aptitudes into account, 
I'm going to—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll definitely win the Oka Sho, 
and after that, I'll conquer the NHK Mile 
Cup for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
S-Such an unconventional rotation...?! If 
I recall, no one has ever won that before—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's why I have to do it. I'll 
show everyone I can!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Something only I can do. I'll seize a 
radiance that's uniquely mine!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to be someone's inspiration too— as 
a Tiara Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So――everyone. I won't lose in the Oka Sho 
either.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I won't give it up. I'll hold on. I'll 
keep showing my back to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Until the moment I dive across the finish 
line first!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ngh, —

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I am sooooo tired today too~...! Put 
away the equipment, and we're finally 
done~!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I'm starving! Let's get back to the 
dorms already.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~... Wait, Heart? Huh, you're not 
going?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Aah, sorry! I just got bothered by how 
cluttered the warehouse was.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to tidy up a bit. You guys head 
on home first!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's sooo good of you! Of course 
we'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine! Just a personal 
preference of mine. More importantly, 
could you go ahead and snag us some good 
seats in the dorm cafeteria?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's a TV show I reaaally 
want to watch today!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Aha, seriously? Okay, okay, I'll keep 
looking dead straight ahead!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"You're tired, so don't stay up too late, 
okay! See ya later~."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yeah, bye!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Craft... To think that after the Oka Sho, 
you'd aim to conquer the NHK Mile Cup 
next.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Really... what a girl...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Win the Triple Tiara and become an 
Umamusume worthy of the title "Queen."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That is my purpose. My dream. ...The 
single ambition I hold in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For that sole purpose, I crossed the 
ocean. I had no intention of returning 
until I saw it through. ...That was my 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Donning the crown of cherry blossoms. 
Claiming the throne of the Oaks. To bloom 
as a magnificent flower in the autumn."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That... that alone is my—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ......Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Both in the Hanshin JF and the Fillies' 
Revue. You have shown a drive, a 
brilliance, and... a radiance as an 
Umamusume that surpasses my own.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
She made me feel the gap between us. 
That's why I saw her as a wall. The 
greatest wall standing between me and the 
queen's throne.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A wall that I wished, yearned, and 
hungered to surpass... and gritted my 
teeth at every time it stood before my 
eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... if she truly has no intention 
of aiming for the Oaks..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It means our paths have parted, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: However...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Why did I...—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, speaking of the Oka Sho... 
there's the genius prodigy Nishino 
Flower's running, and also—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The second Triple Tiara winner in history, 
Still in Love! Her running was truly 
unforgettable, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The very first bout in a high-stakes clash 
between rivals that drew so much 
attention…… My heart was racing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I may not be able to aim for the 
Triple Tiara like she did, but..."
choice_data_list:
Still, you have your own path—one that 
belongs only to you.

But you have your own path, a path that's 
yours alone

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes. Isn't that right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out. ...I will see this 
through to the end!
